reference: GNU diffutils cmp independently checks status, stdout bytes, diagnostic presence and relative fixture trees. Bash type/help metadata follow the published byte-comparison interface.
coverage: Identical binary files containing NUL and high-bit bytes
Default first-difference byte and line diagnostic
Silent equal and different results with status capture
Two positional skip counts and silent comparison after skipping
One stdin operand through a bounded shell pipeline
Unequal lengths and EOF diagnostic behavior
Missing input and invalid skip count errors
Bash builtin type and help metadata contract
exclusions: No deferred cases: all selected operations use small private fixture files or bounded shell pipelines and require no privilege, hardware, network, terminal driver, or external mock.
Timed fragmented-pipe schedules, injected I/O faults and very large streams remain outside this bounded suite; no external project test results are claimed here.

cases.purpose: Confirm byte equality for a small binary fixture containing NUL, newline, DEL, and high-bit bytes.
cases.script: printf '\000A\n\177\200\377' > left; printf '\000A\n\177\200\377' > right; cmp left right

cases.purpose: Check that -s emits nothing while equal and differing comparisons return 0 and 1 respectively.
cases.script: printf 'same' > equal_a; printf 'same' > equal_b; printf 'diff' > other; if cmp -s equal_a equal_b; then same=0; else same=$?; fi; if cmp -s equal_a other; then different=0; else different=$?; fi; printf 'same=%s different=%s\n' "$same" "$different"

cases.purpose: Compare every -l record for several differences, including a zero and high-bit octet; exact stdout checks formatting and values.
cases.script: printf '\001A\377' > left; printf '\002B\000' > right; cmp -l left right

cases.purpose: Exercise POSIX positional skip counts with equal suffixes and a later silent comparison that still differs.

printf 'abTAIL

' "$equal" "$different" "$past_eof"

cases.purpose: Check the unequal-length result and EOF diagnostic when the shorter file ends after matching bytes.
cases.script: printf 'ABC\n' > longer; printf 'ABC' > shorter; cmp longer shorter

cases.purpose: Check GNU-compatible error status for an unreadable named operand while allowing implementation-specific diagnostic wording.
Check the error status for a nonnumeric positional skip count.
cases.script: printf 'a' > left; printf 'a' > right; cmp left right nope

cases.purpose: Use Bash builtins to confirm cmp is registered as a builtin and its documented byte-comparison and single-stdin contract appears in help.
cases.script: kind=$(type -t cmp); doc=$(help cmp); [[ $kind == builtin ]] || exit 1; [[ $doc == *"Byte-compare two files."* ]] || exit 1; [[ $doc == *"Either file may be '-' to read stdin (but only one)."* ]] || exit 1; printf 'builtin; byte-compare help; one stdin operand documented\n'
cases.stdout: builtin; byte-compare help; one stdin operand documented
